caption: The drawing depicts a side view of a cow-shaped object with a predominantly greenish-blue and brown coloration, displayed against a plain, off-white background. The cow figure is simplified and stylized, with its body largely rectangular and flattened, and only two legs visible on each side. The head of the cow, which faces left, is detailed with a grayish tone, a visible ocular area, two horns (one of which curves forward), and a visible ear. The tail hangs down close to the rear right leg. The cow's body and legs rest on a horizontal brown rod that runs parallel to the bottom edge of the image, intersected vertically by a shorter rod beneath the cow's front legs. The overall composition centers the cow figure within the frame, with no additional objects or background elements present. The greenish-blue areas suggest oxidation or patina typical of aged metal, while the brown hues appear along the edges and at stress points of the form.
title: Steer Weather Vane
